text:
Type: backless metal bar stool
Use: seating at a kitchen island, bar or high counter; kitchen, dining room, studio
Style: industrial, retro, farmhouse
Materials: beige powder-coated steel, round metal seat with a center hand hole, exposed bolts
Colors: pale beige, warm cream, silver bolt heads
Shape: round flat seat on four slim tubular legs that splay at the feet, square footrest ring, visible bolts, tall and light
Feel: utilitarian, retro, casual
Goes with: white tiles, butcher-block wood, enamel and cream tones; industrial or farmhouse kitchens, retro diners

product.name: RSKOG
product.description: Easy to move thanks to the hole in the seat.
